info.title: Parsley Parser Synthesizer
info.description: An advanced LL parser synthesizer for C#

options.name: --lexer
options.description:
The lexer output file to generate. Terminals from
other lexers (lexer=Name) go in files beside it,
named like grammar.Name.lex.

options.name: --output
options.description:
The path to the ouput code file. Defaults to
<stdout>.

options.name: --shared
options.description:
Generate the shared runtime: ParsleyRuntime.cs
and the parser base class for the grammar's
engine.

options.name: --base
options.description:
Generate only the parser base class for the
grammar's engine (LL1ParserBase.cs,
LLkParserBase.cs or AllStarParserBase.cs), for a
project that already has ParsleyRuntime.cs.

options.name: --engine
options.description:
The parsing engine: auto (the lightest the
grammar allows), ll1, llk or allstar. Defaults to
auto.

options.name: --report
options.description:
Write a report on the grammar to <stdout> instead
of a parser: the engine it needs and why, its
decisions and lookahead, and the size of the
synthesized code.
